name: Batch 05 · Bounce after dark
status: Published/imported and verified; 50 new unrated candidates. Not an approved party sequence.

selection_policy.grove: Upbeat, fun, happy, hopeful, loving and new beginnings; bouncy, melodic and sexy. No acid/techno; avoid chart-pop/top-five-hit character, sad music and negative lyrics.
selection_policy.hollow: High energy, bouncy, hard, dark and fast. This batch prioritizes hard bounce and fast rave/trance with a smaller compact acid/techno lane; no new DnB this round.
selection_policy.separation: Distinct rooms and moods; shared house vocabulary allowed. No duplicate recordings across rooms.
selection_policy.evidence_limit: Lyric themes, editorial sound hypotheses, catalog descriptors and actual-file analysis are separate. No complete exact-edit lyric or listening certification.

selection_method: Completed host votes plus explicit style correction; individually source exact recordings, including suitable private saved-library candidates. A global Spotify Like never confers room approval. Interleave editorial lanes with weighted spacing and avoid nearby repeated credited artists.

feedback_basis.interpretation: 27 hard bounce / 15 rave-trance / 8 compact acid-techno. Pause new DnB probes after zero of three this round and one of seven before; preserve all existing DnB Keeps.

audit.listening_status: Catalog identity and metadata checked; no full audio audition, acoustic identity proof or rendered mix.

privacy_note: Full saved-library exports, per-recording saved membership/timestamps, OAuth data, review backups and lyric caches stay ignored. Portable candidates contain no personal saved-state flags or lyric transcripts.
